ei.title: 글의 목적 — Qukkon Gold Rush 자원봉사

fullPassage:
To Whom It May Concern,
I recently visited the Lambsford History Foundation's exhibition about the Qukkon Gold Rush. The collection of pictures, tools, and historical documents made the gold miners arriving to Qukkon come to life. This reminded me of when I lived in Qukkon and worked in the mining industry. Because of this, I'm wondering if there are volunteer guide positions available for this exhibition. I can share my experiences working in the extreme cold of Qukkon. Again, I would be thankful if you could tell me about the availability of volunteer positions as a guide.
Sincerely,
Jonathan Hamilton

questions.passage:
To Whom It May Concern,
I recently visited the Lambsford History Foundation's exhibition about the Qukkon Gold Rush. The collection of pictures, tools, and historical documents made the gold miners arriving to Qukkon come to life. This (A)[reminded / distracted] me of when I lived in Qukkon and worked in the mining industry. Because of this, I'm (B)[wondering / refusing] if there are volunteer guide positions (C)[available / unavailable] for this exhibition. I can share my experiences working in the extreme cold of Qukkon. Again, I would be thankful if you could tell me about the availability of volunteer positions as a guide.
Sincerely,
Jonathan Hamilton
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: 이것이 나에게 상기시켜(reminded), 자원봉사 자리가 있는지 궁금해하며(wondering), 가능한(available) 자리.
det.analysis:
✅ ① reminded — wondering — available: 원문 그대로
❌ ② distracted(산만하게 한): reminded의 반의어
❌ ③ refusing(거부하는): wondering과 반대
❌ ④ unavailable(불가능한): available의 반의어

questions.passage: I recently visited the Lambsford History Foundation's (A)[exhibition / concealment] about the Qukkon Gold Rush. The collection of pictures, tools, and historical documents made the gold miners arriving to Qukkon come to life. This reminded me of when I lived in Qukkon and worked in the mining industry. I can share my (B)[experiences / ignorance] working in the extreme cold of Qukkon. Again, I would be (C)[thankful / resentful] if you could tell me about the availability of volunteer positions as a guide.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.analysis:

❌ ④ resentful(원망하는): thankful의 반의어
